blockers.finding: The Oracle Constitution IV records: 'Standalone 2W washout-turn on sector ETFs: NULL pooled (P8; loses to the validated sector_signals BUY state).' The program's twice-verified anchor is that the washout edge lives in FLOW DISPLACEMENT (A15 = opposite-complex outflow, the durable +1.3% winner), NOT price velocity. C6 deletes the flow clause and substitutes a deep-negative `vel_1w` price-speed threshold. P8 P-W2 cond_a (washout x RS-acceleration, a price-velocity conditioner) produced a NEGATIVE increment (-0.31%), adjudicated 'entry after acceleration is LATE.' C6 is therefore the registered-NULL standalone washout plus a conditioner in the family shown to add nothing or subtract. 'washout' and 'deep-negative weekly velocity' are near-tautological (both encode recent sharp price decline), so the secondary conditioner is not mechanistically independent of the trigger.

blockers.finding: Primary hit_63d gate FAILS: observed_hit_63d=0.5374 < gate_hit_63d=0.55 (floor_passed.hit63_ge_55pct=false). The candidate cleared the mechanical floor ONLY on |effect63|>=1% at 1.03% — barely above the 1.0% floor and squarely inside the noise band P8 established for pooled washout (P-W1 63d ranged +0.45% pooled to +1.29% by era; era_consistent=3/4 exactly mirrors P-W1). The promotion_queue.json note states 'QUEUE ONLY — not promoted.' A 1.03% effect with a failed hit gate at search_width_at_scan=110 (batch FDR scope) is consistent with a multiple-testing artifact, not a discovery.

The `-0.03` threshold in `vel_1w<-0.03` is an un-registered, un-derived magic scalar. It appears nowhere in the P8 prereg or R1 gauntlet docs; A17 used the sign-only cut `vel_1w<0`. Choosing a specific magnitude cut (-0.03) is a free tuning knob that adds untracked trials on top of the already-counted washout family. Constitution II: a fixed scalar proxy must be labeled by what it IS and grammar/threshold choices are reviewed, not conveniences. trial_accounting.family=null in the packet — this compound family was not pre-registered as a distinct trial-ledger family, so the threshold search is not counted.

near_dup.flagged=false is a false negative here: the structural relationship to A17 and P-W1 is explicit in the registry but the probe's similarity metric did not surface it. Do not rely on that flag for this candidate.

Cost realism: this is a liquid sector-ETF (tier s) entry; even the durable A15 winner is called 'a tilt, not a fortune, net of costs' at ~+1.3%. A 1.03% pooled effect with a failed hit gate is unlikely to survive slippage + financing net-of-cost.
Per-ETF heterogeneity is large (XLE +1.79% vs +0.45% pooled) — pooled numbers here may be carried by a few sectors; naming which post-hoc would itself be trial-mining (constitution ruling).
reviewer.best_counterargument: Deepening the velocity screen (vel_1w<-0.03 vs A17's <0) could in principle isolate genuine capitulation from mild drift, and the pooled +1.03% 63d effect with 3/4 positive eras is directionally consistent with the operator's 'buy weekly capitulation' thesis and with A17's mechanism minus the flow requirement — arguably a cheaper, more universally-firable version (n=1667 vs A17's n=262) that trades A17's flow-displacement precision for breadth. If the program's true edge is capitulation-mean-reversion and flow-displacement is only one route to identifying it, a price-velocity route could recover a diluted but still-real slice of the same effect. That is why it is worth a human glance rather than a silent kill.
reviewer.minimum_fix_to_reconsider: Re-cast as a distinct, pre-registered trial family with the -0.03 threshold justified ex-ante (not fit), then run the full R1/P3-style gauntlet (OOS split + count-matched per-node timing placebo + block-bootstrap CI + BH-FDR over the real trial count including the velocity-threshold search). It must clear the hit_63d>=0.55 gate AND demonstrate a positive INCREMENT over the standalone P-W1 washout base rate (not merely over zero) — i.e., prove the velocity clause adds edge beyond the registered-NULL standalone washout. Absent that increment, it is P-W1 re-labeled.
reviewer.falsifier_spec: In a pre-registered forward window, C6's mean 63d excess-vs-SPY does NOT exceed the P8 P-W1 standalone-washout base rate (+0.45%/50.7% pooled) by a positive, bootstrap-CI-clearing increment, AND its 63d hit rate stays below the sector_signals BUY base rate (56%). If the conditioned entry cannot beat the unconditioned washout it is built on, the 'deep weekly velocity stress' conditioner is confirmed to add nothing and the mechanism is dead.
reviewer.human_review_question: Should C6 be rejected as a duplicate re-run of the already-adjudicated-NULL standalone washout (P-W1) and a flow-clause-stripped subset of the gauntleted A17 — YES to kill/defer, or NO to spend one registered gauntlet shot testing whether the deep-velocity screen produces a positive increment over the standalone-washout base rate?
